sections.title: The NOvA Test Beam Experiment
sections.abstract: The NOvA Collaboration reports on a 30-ton test-beam detector, operated at Fermilab from 2019–2022, to constrain detector response, energy calibration, and hadronic/electromagnetic energy resolution for long-baseline neutrino analyses.
sections.claimed_result: The test-beam data improve understanding of dominant detector-response and energy-scale uncertainties in NOvA analyses.
sections.caveat: Calibration result, not a new oscillation measurement or discovery.

sections.title: Island of Inversion in neutron-rich cobalt isotopes revealed from mass measurements
sections.abstract: Penning-trap masses and nuclear-structure calculations establish the ordering of low- and high-spin states in neutron-rich cobalt and show an inversion in 70Co as intruder states descend beyond N=40.
sections.claimed_result: The authors report a gradual lowering of intruder states culminating in an inversion in 70Co, with induced effective three-nucleon forces important for binding-energy calculations.

sections.title: Generating is not discovering: a pre-registered physics judge for AI-proposed superconductors, calibrated on six known superconductors and one negative control
sections.abstract: A preregistered DFT/Wannier/RPA pipeline tests whether AI-generated materials are stable, superconducting, and plausibly manufacturable.
sections.claimed_result: The judge recovers known classes and finds no MatterGen candidate simultaneously new, stable, and carrying the tested pairing motif in the reported audit.
sections.caveat: Conclusions depend on model choices; the abstract reports a post-hoc resolution of one criterion issue.

sections.title: Geometric Ginzburg-Landau theory of charge ordering and commensurability
sections.abstract: The authors extend Ginzburg–Landau theory with quantum-geometric contributions and derive a criterion for charge-density-wave formation and commensurability transitions.
sections.claimed_result: Quantum geometry can enhance or suppress CDW formation and commensurability through electronic effects.
sections.caveat: Framework and benchmark, not a new experimental observation.

sections.title: Wave optical imaging of an oscillating electric dipole orbiting a black hole
sections.abstract: A first-principles Kerr-spacetime calculation produces wave-optical images of an orbiting oscillating dipole, including relativistic beaming, lensing, Einstein rings, and helicity-dependent polarization effects.
sections.claimed_result: Opposite dipole helicities produce a relative image displacement that roughly scales inversely with radiation frequency.
sections.caveat: Benchmark calculation, not an observation; realistic-source detectability remains open.

sections.title: Emergence of Gravity's Dynamical and Topological Sectors from Pre-geometry
sections.abstract: A pre-geometric gauge construction is proposed whose five irreducible building blocks generate Einstein–Hilbert dynamics, a cosmological term, and four-dimensional topological invariants after symmetry breaking.
sections.claimed_result: The authors identify a minimal generating set for their pre-geometric action and derive relations involving gravitational and topological couplings.
sections.caveat: Framework-dependent claims require consistency checks and phenomenological constraints.
